title: Scalar-linear reconstruction mate square
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $\ell$ a prime invertible in $k$, $\Omega$ an algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and $f:X\to Y$ proper between separated finite-type $k$-schemes. Let $D$ be prescribed strict integral direct-image comparison data satisfying HasIntegralLaws [lem-sf-strict-direct-image-scalar-comparison], and $E\subset L$ finite coefficient subextensions. Choose normalized reduction calculi, scalar systems, coefficient reduction data, limit comparisons and restriction comparison $C$ [def-weil-strict-mixed-unit-data]. Write $s_W$ for the coefficient reduction isomorphism $R_L T_W\cong S_W R_E$, $r_E,r_L$ for the reconstruction reduction mates, $b$ for the inverse integral comparison, and $q_N$ for the scalar-adjunction transpose of $G_E(\zeta^X_N)$ followed by $C^{-1}_{S_XN}$. For every integral constructible $K$ over $E$ on $X$, the following equality holds on entire derived quotient systems: $s_{Y,I_EK}^{-1};R_L(b_K);r_{L,T_XK};G_L(s_{X,K})=S_Y(r_{E,K});q_{R_EK}$. Semicolon denotes composition in displayed order. This is an equality of scalar-linear maps before applying restriction or precomposing with the scalar unit.

proof.text:
Let $q_N:S_YG_EN\to G_LS_XN$ be the coefficient-adjunction mate of $d$, so
$$U_Y(q_N)\zeta^Y_{G_EN}=d_{S_XN}G_E(\zeta^X_N).$$
It is also the geometric counit/tensor mate: applying [lem-trf-iterated-square-mates] to the pullback/scalar-association square identifies its twice-transposed comparison with the restriction/direct-image comparison $d$; this applies because $d$ is the conjugate of that square by Step 1 [lem-sfb-ringed-comparison-tensor-adjunction], and injectivity of the mate bijections gives this identification. Likewise, by Step 2 and [lem-trf-iterated-square-mates], $\alpha_H$ is the geometric mate of the pullback/reduction square. Let $c:C_YF_E\to F_LC_X$ be the ambient counit/tensor mate used to define $b_*$. Paste the coefficient/reduction squares in the two orders. On the left-adjoint side, one order uses $\widehat R_E\to\widehat R_L\to B_\bullet$, the other $\widehat R_E\to A_\bullet\to B_\bullet$. They are the same ring map. Their pullback/tensor identifications agree: on a representative they send $((x\otimes s)\otimes b)$ to $x\otimes\bar s b$, and further association multiplies the same scalars in the same order. Naturality in the ring maps in [lem-sfb-successive-derived-quotient-normalization] proves this on the sequence sites with their transitions. Taking geometric mates, the horizontal and vertical pasting identities of [lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting] now give
$$G_L(e_X)\,\alpha_{L,C_XK}\,\mathcal R_L^Y(c_K)
=q_{\mathcal R_E^XK}\,S_Y(\alpha_{E,K})\,e_{Y,F_EK}.$$
This is an equality of system maps. The argument is a mate of the specified equality of left-adjoint comparisons, so does not infer it from componentwise equality.

source.place: Tag 0B56 (equation-projection-formula-map) for the counit transpose; Tags 0E46 and 0E47 (remark-compose-base-change and remark-compose-base-change-horizontal) for the two pastings. The precise pasting and iterated-transpose identities are cited as nodes.

proof.text:
By [lem-sf-strict-direct-image-scalar-comparison], the prescribed $b_*$ is $c$ transported through $\psi_E,\psi_L,\chi_X,\chi_Y$. Substitute $r_H\mathcal R_H\psi_H=\alpha_H$ and $s_W\mathcal R_L\chi_W=e_W$ from Steps 2–3 into the equation of Step 4. Naturality cancels the reconstruction and completion isomorphisms, giving, with $N=\mathcal R_E^XK$,
$$G_L(s_{X,K})\,r_{L,T_XK}\,\mathcal R_L^Y(b_{*,K})
=q_N\,S_Y(r_{E,K})\,s_{Y,I_EK}. \tag{*}$$
For clarity, apply $U_Y$ to (*) and precompose with $\eta_{Y,I_EK}$. Its right side becomes
$$U_Y(q_N)\,U_YS_Y(r_{E,K})\,\zeta^Y_{\mathcal R_E^YI_EK}
=U_Y(q_N)\,\zeta^Y_{G_EN}\,r_{E,K}
=d_{S_XN}\,G_E(\zeta^X_N)\,r_{E,K}.$$
The first equality is unit naturality and the second is the defining equation for $q$. Replace $\zeta^X_N$ by $U_X(s_{X,K})\eta_{X,K}$ and use naturality of $d$. This last expression is
$$U_YG_L(s_{X,K})\,d_{\mathcal R_L^XT_XK}\,G_E(\eta_{X,K})\,r_{E,K}.$$
Cancel the isomorphism $U_YG_L(s_{X,K})$ from the two sides. We obtain the requested equation on entire $A_{E,\bullet}$-systems.

    (C : RestrictionComparison l (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω e)
      (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω j)
      (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.coefficientInclusion l Ω e j h) f)

      X) :
    (coefficientExtensionReductionIso l (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω e)

      l Ω e) (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω j)
      (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.coefficientInclusion l Ω e j h) X).obj K) ≫
      (FrobeniusExchange.systemDirect l (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω j)
      f).map
        ((coefficientExtensionReductionIso l (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω e)
      (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω j)
      (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.coefficientInclusion l Ω e j h) X EX LX AX dX).hom.app K.obj)
      =
    AY.scalar.T.map (reductionMap l (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω e) f EX EY
